about: Locator.X asset-class crosswalk: per-jurisdiction use-code vocabularies mapped to the platform's screening classes. Every code entry carries the source it was verified against and the date; entries with verified=null are transcribed from a published manual but not yet measured against a live layer (the pull-recipe hard rule: never guess a use code). Counts are measured parcel counts from the documented pulls, not estimates. Jurisdictions may also declare ranking fields where the pulls or documented layouts support them: value_field (what a top-properties rank may honestly sort on — an ASSESSMENT, not a price), locality_fields (city/district/neighborhood columns for search facets), and dedupe_key (the measured key that collapses multi-polygon duplicates). Absent fields mean unknown — scripts must not guess them.

classes.lodging: Hotels, motels, resorts, B&Bs — hospitality stock (curriculum A2: the five classes; shortest lease of all)
classes.small_multifamily_2_4: 2-4 unit residential — the agency-financeable small end
classes.student_housing: Purpose-identified student stock — the campus-ring lens (A7, launi edition)
classes.mixed_residential: Store/office + apartment and residential conversions — conversion-engine candidates (A7)

jurisdictions.name: Wake County, NC
jurisdictions.source: Wake Property/Parcels FeatureServer/0 groupBy, docs/PULL_RECIPE.md additions 2026-09-05
caveats: H/M-* suffixes are not documented anywhere public — treat the family as lodging and keep the raw string
TOTUNITS is a billing/appraisal unit count of ANY kind, not dwelling units — only a real unit count when ANDed with a residential decode
No bedroom or bathroom field; HEATEDAREA is the only floor area
Use the FeatureServer sibling — the MapServer returns NULL for every statistic
jurisdictions.ranking_note: Measured 2026-09-05: TOTAL_VALUE_ASSD is 0 on HOA/condo-complex shell parcels (value sits on unit rows) — a zero-value row is a shell, not a bargain.

jurisdictions.name: Utah County, UT
jurisdictions.source: Utah County parcel layer groupBy (37-value distribution), docs/PULL_RECIPE.md additions 2026-09-05
caveats: TOTAL_UNIT_COUNT is trustworthy on APARTMENTS / STUDENT HOUSING / SUBSIDIZE HOUSING (max 478, median 12) — NOT on LODGING (not a room count) and NOT on CONDO rows (complex count repeated per unit)
YEARBLT_RES is populated on 2.5% of apartments — use YEAR_BUILT_1 (94%) for anything non-single-family
ASMT_YEAR is 2027 on nearly every row — the roll is the 2027 tax year

jurisdictions.name: Bernalillo County, NM
jurisdictions.source: assessormap.bernco.gov Assessor_Parcels_Public/MapServer/0 (152-value LUC_MSG, 100% populated), docs/PULL_RECIPE.md additions 2026-09-05
caveats: O4U = over 4 units, U4U = under 4 units — the 5+ boundary is the county's own
No sale price and no sale date on any layer — New Mexico is non-disclosure; value evidence is assessment-only
Use the county's own ArcGIS server, not the state OSE layer (which has no usable use class in some counties, e.g. Sandoval)
jurisdictions.ranking_note: Measured 2026-09-05: TOTVALUE 99.9% populated. Non-disclosure state — this is an assessment, no sale prices exist.

jurisdictions.name: Ohio (statewide DTE codes; verified on Franklin and Mahoning)
jurisdictions.source: Ohio Administrative Code Rule 5703-25-10 (https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-administrative-code/rule-5703-25-10); county verification in docs/PULL_RECIPE.md additions 2026-09-04/05
caveats: 401 spans 4-19 units, so it straddles the 5+ boundary — an Ohio '5+ only' screen needs the unit count, not the code alone
Single-digit county variants (404-409, 413, 414, 417, ...) are NOT in the state rule — band by prefix only and label them not-use-verified
Franklin: 'CONDO 40+ RENTAL UNITS' rows are individually-owned condo units (58,563 rows, max $794,500) — exclude from complex screens deliberately
Franklin: BLDGAREA is the only floor-area field that works for apartments; there is NO year-built for an apartment parcel in the layer
Marion County IN uses the same numbering — the crosswalk row applies there with the same caveats

jurisdictions.name: Maricopa County, AZ
jurisdictions.source: ADOR class manual, verified against the live layer, docs/PULL_RECIPE.md additions 2026-09-04
caveats: 04-2 is NOT a separate hotel class — hotels are 04-1 only, with 4th-digit story variants; a '041x/042x' filter happens to work for the wrong reason
FCV_CUR is a string with embedded commas and leading spaces — keep the raw string and parse a numeric beside it (server-side CAST verified working)
LIVING_SPACE is 0% populated; CONST_YEAR is 100%
jurisdictions.ranking_note: Measured 2026-09-04: FCV_CUR is a comma-embedded string with leading spaces — parse numerically, keep the raw.

jurisdictions.name: Onondaga County, NY (NYS Tax Parcels)
caveats: USED_AS_DESC is the best plain-English multifamily form descriptor in the catalogue — prefer it over the numeric class band
SQ_FT is LOT square footage; GFA is gross floor area (89% populated in the 4xx band)
PRINT_KEY is unique only within a municipality — key on (PRINT_KEY, CITYTOWN_NAME)
jurisdictions.ranking_note: Measured 2026-09-04: PRINT_KEY unique only within a municipality — dedupe on the pair. No value field measured; a rank here would be a guess, so none is declared.

jurisdictions.name: Guilford County, NC
caveats: TOTAL_UNITS is a complex-level count repeated onto every row and absent on the largest apartments — rank on TOTAL_PROP_VALUE + ACREAGE, never TOTAL_UNITS
APT_SC_SQRFT is in the schema and 100% NULL — do not plan around it
PIN is not unique — the same PIN appears on separate lots in one subdivision
jurisdictions.ranking_note: Measured 2026-09-04: rank on TOTAL_PROP_VALUE + ACREAGE, never TOTAL_UNITS.

jurisdictions.name: Florida (statewide DOR NAL use codes)
jurisdictions.source: FL DOR NAL user guide code list — transcribed, NOT yet measured against a pulled roll (wave-one probe pending; see docs/states/coverage/florida.md)
caveats: UNVERIFIED against a live roll — the fl_nal_probe.py run must confirm the code dictionary before these rows are relied on (the pull-recipe hard rule)
008 spans 2-9 units, so it straddles the 5+ boundary both ways — Florida's 5+ screen needs NO_RES_UNTS, not the code alone
jurisdictions.ranking_note: JV is just value from the DOR roll (documented NAL layout); locality fields from the same layout. Unverified until the NAL probe runs, like the codes.
